up: Find all molecules reported in document CHEMBL1125820. Return the following columns: molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), pref_name (from molecule_dictionary), max_phase (from molecule_dictionary), molecule_type (from molecule_dictionary), and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Join activities with docs using doc_id = CHEMBL1125820. Join activities with molecule_dictionary using molecule_chembl_id. Join activities with compound_structures using molecule_chembl_id. Return distinct rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN activities a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1125820'
